init.description:
**Polling** covers the live power, current and voltage sensors only. The real-time readings update every 10 seconds, so a shorter interval buys fresher values and nothing else; the API's rate limits are undocumented, so lower it gradually. Energy is unaffected — it is imported from the Perific cloud rather than accumulated from polling.

**Cost** is optional, and exists because that import is what makes it necessary: Home Assistant refuses to price an energy source it did not record itself, so this integration works the price out and writes its own cost series for the Energy dashboard to use. Leave the price entity empty and none of it happens.

Buying and selling are priced differently. What you buy costs `(spot + markup + energy tax) × VAT`. What you sell earns `spot + export premium`, with no tax and no VAT, because a household selling surplus charges neither.

data_description.price_entity: A sensor giving the spot price per kWh, excluding VAT — a Nord Pool price sensor, for instance. Leave it empty and no cost is imported at all. Prices can only be read as far back as this sensor's own history goes, so cost will start later than the energy it prices.
data_description.price_markup: Your supplier's markup per kWh on electricity you buy, excluding VAT. Any other per-kWh charge, such as grid transfer, belongs here too. Not applied to what you sell.
data_description.energy_tax: Energy tax per kWh on electricity you buy, excluding VAT. The published Swedish figure of 53.50 öre/kWh includes VAT, so the number to enter is 42.80 öre — that is 0.4280. Not applied to what you sell.
data_description.vat_percent: Applied to the spot price, the markup and the tax together, for electricity you buy. 25 in Sweden. Not applied to what you sell.
data_description.export_price_entity: Leave empty unless you sell at a different spot price than you buy — the entity above is then used for both. This only shares the price: what you sell is still earned at spot plus the premium below, with no markup, no tax and no VAT.
data_description.export_premium: Added to the spot price per kWh for what you sell. This is the only adjustment made to export; the markup, energy tax and VAT above apply to what you buy.

rate_limited.title: Perific is rate limiting requests
rate_limited.description:
The Perific API is refusing requests because they are arriving too quickly, so the sensors will stay unavailable until it lets us back in.

The poll interval is currently {seconds} seconds. Raise it under Settings > Devices & services > Perific > Configure. This message disappears on its own once a poll succeeds.

import_history.name: Import energy history
import_history.description: Imports hourly energy statistics from the Perific cloud. Runs by itself every hour; use this to force a rebuild from a chosen point.

start.name: Start
start.description: Import from this moment onwards, replacing what is already stored. Leave empty to continue from wherever the last import stopped.
